<?php
function peerShift217() { global $late, $owner, $runner; $late = 99; $owner = null; $runner = null; echo 'SHIFT;'; return false; }
class PeerScopeBase217 { public string $text; public function __construct($text) { $this->text = $text; echo 'CTOR;'; } public function capture($saved, $marker) { $this->text = $saved; echo 'BASE:', self::class, ':', static::class, ';'; return $this; } public function __destruct() { echo 'THIS-END;'; } }
class PeerScopeMid217 extends PeerScopeBase217 { public function capture($saved, $marker) { echo 'WRONG;'; return $this; } public function run() { global $owner, $late; return $owner->MiSsInG(first: (parent::capture(...))($late, peerShift217()), later: false); } }
class PeerScopeChild217 extends PeerScopeMid217 {}
class PeerBase217 { public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { global $alias; $alias = 0; echo 'MAGIC:', $arguments['first']->text, ';'; return false; } public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; } } class PeerDerived217 extends PeerBase217 {}
$owner = new PeerDerived217; $prefix = 'REQUEST-'; $late = $prefix . 'OLD'; $alias =& $late; $runner = new PeerScopeChild217($late);
$result = $runner->run(); echo 'RETURN;'; unset($alias); unset($late); echo $result ? 'BAD;' : 'FALSE;'; echo 'AFTER;';
